subject: Civic Education
competence: Broad curriculum competency standard in plain English
lesson: Explains the good qualities of a worker: Thematic Station Jigsaw & Infographic Wall: Competency Level 8.6.5
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the good qualities of a worker.
Expresses the importance of maintaining good qualities in the work place.
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: Imagine you are a new employee at a local factory in Sri Lanka. What qualities do you think are essential for a worker to possess to excel in their role?

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Organizes students into 8 teams (8 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. Distributes student notebooks and chart paper.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students receive their assigned roles and begin to organize their investigation by exploring the 'Thematic Station Jigsaw' board, discussing the importance of maintaining good qualities in the workplace, and mapping the key ideas.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Circulates among student groups, facilitating role execution, and providing outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Encourages students to explore the 'Thematic Station Jigsaw' board, discuss the importance of maintaining good qualities in the workplace, and map the key ideas.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students continue to explore the 'Thematic Station Jigsaw' board, discuss the importance of maintaining good qualities in the workplace, and map the key ideas. They begin to synthesize their findings and prepare for group presentations.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Monitors student group presentations, provides feedback, and synthesizes the key ideas. Encourages students to reflect on the importance of maintaining good qualities in the workplace and the qualities of a good worker.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students present their group's concrete artifacts/solutions from the activity, receive peer feedback, and reflect on the importance of maintaining good qualities in the workplace and the qualities of a good worker.

assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Formative feedback criteria: Peer feedback on group presentations, teacher observation of student roles, and class discussion on the importance of maintaining good qualities in the workplace.
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: In-class quiz: 'What are the good qualities of a worker?' (2-minute rapid-fire quiz with 5 questions)
